The *Abhejjaparisapañha* ("An Assembly Without Schism", Mil 5.2.8) is a dialogue situated in the fifth division of the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. The text deals with canonical themes concerning monastic harmony and the inviolability of an assembly, connecting with passages such as the *Lakkhaṇa Sutta* of the Dīgha Nikāya (DN 30, PTS DN iii 142) and the *Saṁghabhedakakkhandhaka* of the Vinaya Khandhaka (Kd 17) [SuttaCentral]. On SuttaCentral, three translations across three languages are indexed [SuttaCentral].

Additional textual reuses are shared with Mil 5.5.9, Mil 5.5.3, Mil 5.3.12, and Mil 5.2.6 [DharmaNexus].
